SELECT
    RAWTOHEX(r.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(r.STATUS_ID) AS STATUS_ID,
    s.STATUS_CODE,
    s.STATUS_NAME,
    s.FLOW_STATUS_STEP_NO,
    s.DESCRIPTION
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST r
JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_STATUS s
    ON s.STATUS_ID = r.STATUS_ID
WHERE r.REQUEST_ID =
    HEXTORAW(
        REPLACE(
            '{{JS_LIB.getRequestId()}}',
            '-',
            ''
        )
    )
